ping.description: Agent runtime self-test: streams from the router role, emits a block, interrupts to confirm, records to agent_health

tavily_usage.description: Daily reconciliation of Tavily's usage reading with Naadi's own ledger (records only)

coach.description: Nightly study coach: facts -> validated suggestions for Today (rules fallback when the job budget is spent)

youtube_map.description: Weekly YouTube mapper: refresh or drop stored metadata (30-day policy), score new uploads of allow-listed channels offline, queue candidates for approval

author.description: Question authoring: coverage gaps -> draft -> NBME lint -> citation check -> blind solve by a different model family -> human review queue; nightly item statistics

ink_ocr.description: Handwriting search: idle ink layers -> Pillow tiles -> one vision call per tile -> recognized_text (sweep every 2 min, nightly retry of deferred layers)
